round_interpretation: Round one increased hypervolume by 19.78%. Removing rank improved IC/Sharpe in the credit model; removing autocorrelation improved all objectives in the no-lag rate model. Credit and volatility additions improved different objectives, while deleting the genuine nominal/TIPS rate state was harmful. A smaller equivalent curve basis improved the density model. Round two tests lag in the new contexts, combines local pruning and credit/rate bridges, and explores oil without forcing lag removal.
default_expected_tradeoff: Retain full IC/NLL/conventional-Sharpe tradeoffs, paired seed effects and calibration diagnostics. Input count is a simplification descriptor, not a fourth objective.
default_falsification: A dominated outcome does not support the conditional feature change. Lag may help one representation and hurt another; neither inclusion frequency nor a single pooled result establishes universal relevance.
